title: DTN: dtn_expire flushes expiry==0 fail-open stores, defeating R-05-080 downstream enforcement
description: Review finding from b7z9.8.2.2 (passes 2+3). lichen_router_dtn_expire (router.c:1264-1287) drops records when (int32_t)(expiry - now) <= 0; an expiry==0 record is purged even at now==0 (clockless). The R-05-080 fail-open path in lichen_router_route_packet (router.c:700-710) stores wire expiry verbatim, so an S-flagged packet with expiry==0 stored on a clockless node is dead on arrival at the first expire sweep instead of being enforced downstream by nodes with valid time. Fix options: skip expiry==0 records in dtn_expire, or store a sentinel. Must coordinate with b7z9.8.1 (wall-clock fail-open semantics) before choosing. Note: dtn_expire currently has no in-tree callers, so this is latent, not live.
close_reason: RE-CLOSE (store write lost — bd8h, recurring). Completed and committed as af7464c967 on beads-worker-7: lichen_router_dtn_expire never flushes expiry==0 (R-05-080 fail-open) records; routing_dispatch host test extended (fail-open survival + positive control); router.h contract documented. 3x codereview PASS.
